content_of_post_to_answer: How do I stop overthinking which content idea to write next?
answer: Overthinking content ideas often happens because we treat choosing as the creative work. But choosing is only a filter; the real learning comes from publishing and seeing what connects. A useful shift is to stop asking “Which idea is the best?” and ask “Which idea teaches me something if I write it?” The creator’s advantage comes from feedback, not from finding a perfect idea in advance.
